decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already records that the É accent must be the literal terminal section of the approved Hero V right arm and cannot be independently redrawn.
A same-message MODIFY already records use of the exact approved Option 2 Hero V signature gesture in the lowercase closing v.
The source reaffirms the previously selected Option 2 Hero V and uses its right-arm terminal as the derivation source; it does not necessarily change the Hero V geometry state itself.
Unifying the signature gesture across the two Vs and É accent does not alter the deferred architectural E and L letterform requirements.
The source changes the second V's shared gesture, not its established smaller and subordinate visual prominence.
The source concerns glyph geometry and derivation and does not change the deferred champagne material treatment.
The design decision does not change the task-local obligation to include rationale with review rounds.
The shared terminal decision does not alter the deferred full-wordmark kerning and reading goal.
The glyph-design decision has no effect on acceptable proof attachment formats.
